message:
- Fixed a rare issue that could prevent some high-stage players from starting the game or damaging monsters.
 - Equipment damage now scales strongly with rarity and item level while respecting its damage type.
 - Offline progression now correctly respects DPS, attack speed and additional monster timer upgrades.
 - Multishot damage is combined into fewer projectiles every 25 levels.
 - Roulette, Gold Store and Soul Store rewards now scale better.
 - Tuning
 - Bugfixes
